name: 初中词汇
description: 初中英语词汇：音标、词性释义、例句与译文。词库基于开源 ECDICT（skywind3000/ECDICT，MIT License）与公开例句数据整理；单词顺序已随机打乱。

words.meaning: adj. 聪明的；巧妙的；敏捷的；厉害的；潇洒的；剧烈的；时髦的；n. (Smart)人名；(法)斯马尔；(英、德)斯马特
words.example: The smart kids get good grades and go off to college.
words.exampleTranslation: 聪明的孩子成绩好，可以去上大学。

words.meaning: n. 爆米花
words.example: Now, do you fancy some popcorn?
words.exampleTranslation: 现在，你想来些爆米花吗？

words.meaning: num. 第十三；n. 十三分之一
words.example: At that moment, the thirteenth fairy arrived.
words.exampleTranslation: 就在这时，第十三位仙女出现了。

words.meaning: v. 游水，游泳；n. 游泳
words.example: Let’s go swimming this afternoon.
words.exampleTranslation: 今天下午我们游泳去吧。

words.meaning: adj. 顺利的；光滑的；平稳的；v. 使光滑；消除（障碍等）；使优雅；缓和；n. 平滑部分；一块平地；adv. 光滑地；平稳地；流畅地
words.example: Her skin felt smooth and cool.
words.exampleTranslation: 她的皮肤摸上去又滑又凉。

words.meaning: n. 票；入场券，标签；（美）候选人名单；证明书；交通罚款单；v. 加标签于；指派；对…开出交通违规罚单
words.example: How much does it say on the price ticket ?
words.exampleTranslation: 价签上标明的价格是多少？

words.meaning: n. 歌手
words.example: the lead singer (= main singer ) of Slade
words.exampleTranslation: 施莱德乐队的主唱

words.meaning: n. 牛仔裤；工装裤
words.example: ...a young man in jeans and a worn T-shirt.
words.exampleTranslation: …一个穿着牛仔裤和破旧T恤衫的年轻人。

words.meaning: adj. 简单的；单纯的；天真的；n. 笨蛋；愚蠢的行为；出身低微者
words.example: a simple but effective solution to the problem
words.exampleTranslation: 对这个问题简单而有效的解决办法

words.meaning: adv. 两次；两倍
words.example: He was questioned by police twice yesterday.
words.exampleTranslation: 他昨天被警察审问了两次。

words.meaning: num. 第十一
words.example: On the eleventh day of Christmas.
words.exampleTranslation: 在圣诞节的第十一天。

words.meaning: n. 命令， 指示； 教学， 教导
words.example: (= I have been told ) to give the package to him personally.
words.exampleTranslation: 我接到的指示是亲手把包裹交给他。

words.meaning: v. 避免；避开，躲避；消除
words.example: Road safety is taught to young children to avoid road accidents.
words.exampleTranslation: 小孩子受到道路安全知识的教育，以避免交通事故。

words.meaning: v. 挥手示意； 波动， 飘动； 高潮， 高涨；n. 波，波浪；挥动
words.example: Enid waved at us and we waved back.
words.exampleTranslation: 伊妮德向我们挥手，我们也向她挥手。

words.meaning: conj. 因为
words.example: We didn’t enjoy the day because the weather was so awful.
words.exampleTranslation: 那天我们很不尽兴，因为天气实在太糟。

words.meaning: n. [食品] 奶酪；干酪；要人；v. 停止；adj. 叛变的；胆小的
words.example: half a kilo of cheese
words.exampleTranslation: 半公斤干酪

words.meaning: adv. 在楼上，向楼上；上楼；往楼上；adj. 楼上的；n. 楼上
words.example: I went upstairs and had a shower.
words.exampleTranslation: 我上楼冲了个澡。

words.meaning: n. 四十；adj. 四十的；四十个的
words.example: The place was built as a casino in the forties.
words.exampleTranslation: 这个地方建于20世纪40年代，起初是一座赌场。

words.meaning: adv. 然后；下次；其次；adj. 下一个的；其次的；贴近的；n. 下一个；prep. 靠近；居于…之后
words.example: When I next saw her she completely ignored me.
words.exampleTranslation: 我再次见到她时，她压根儿没有理我。

words.meaning: n. 洗涤；洗的衣服；化妆水；冲积物；v. 洗涤；洗刷；冲走；拍打
words.example: Those jeans need a good wash (= a thorough wash ).
words.exampleTranslation: 那条牛仔裤要好好洗一洗了。

words.meaning: adj. 乏味的， 单调的； 晦暗的； 愚钝的， 笨的； 钝的
words.example: Outside the weather was hazy and dull.
words.exampleTranslation: 外面薄雾朦胧，天色灰暗。

words.meaning: v. 联合，结合；n. 联合企业； 联合收割机
words.example: Diets are most effective when combined with exercise.
words.exampleTranslation: 节食和锻炼相结合是最有效的。

words.meaning: n. 文章；物品；条款；[语] 冠词；v. 订约将…收为学徒或见习生；使…受协议条款的约束
words.example: The paper’s leading article (=  the main article  ) described the government as weak.
words.exampleTranslation: 该报社论称政府软弱。

words.meaning: adv. 一次；曾经；conj. 一旦；n. 一次，一回
words.example: I’ve only met her once.
words.exampleTranslation: 我只见过她一面。

words.meaning: n. 习惯，风俗；惯例；
words.example: He awoke early, as was his custom.
words.exampleTranslation: 他很早醒来，这是他的习惯。

words.meaning: n. 蜘蛛
words.example: What should I find but an enormous spider!
words.exampleTranslation: 我居然发现了一只巨大的蜘蛛！

words.meaning: n. 成员；会员；议员
words.example: The majority of union members voted in favour of a strike.
words.exampleTranslation: 大多数工会成员投票赞成罢工。

words.meaning: n. 大小；尺寸；adj. 一定尺寸的；v. 依大小排列
words.example: He’s a small boy, about John’s size.
words.exampleTranslation: 他是个小男孩，个子和约翰差不多。

words.meaning: n. 小船；轮船；v. 划船
words.example: a fishing boat
words.exampleTranslation: 渔船

words.meaning: n. 院子；码（英制中丈量长度单位，1码=3英尺）；庭院；帆桁；vt. 把…关进或围在畜栏里
words.example: a hundred yards away
words.exampleTranslation: 100码外

words.meaning: adj. 生气的；愤怒的；狂暴的；（伤口等）发炎的
words.example: I was angry because he hadn’t told me his plans.
words.exampleTranslation: 我很生气，因为他没有告诉我他的计划。

words.meaning: v. 交易；n. 流动的车辆或行人，交通；交易
words.example: The traffic accident had nothing to do with him.
words.exampleTranslation: 这交通事故和他一点关系也没有。

words.meaning: n. 乐队； 群， 伙； 带， 箍； 条纹； 波段， 频带
words.example: The band was playing old Beatles songs.
words.exampleTranslation: 乐队正在演奏披头士的老歌。

words.meaning: n. 时间；时代；次数；节拍；倍数；v. 计时；测定…的时间；安排…的速度；adj. 定时的；定期的；分期的
words.example: Einstein changed the way we think about space and time.
words.exampleTranslation: 爱因斯坦改变了我们的时空概念。

words.meaning: v. [drew-drawn] 画， 描绘； 拖， 拉； 拔出， 抽出； 提取， 汲取； 引起； 吸引； 推
words.example: Katie had drawn a cottage with a little stream running next to it.
words.exampleTranslation: 凯蒂画了一间小茅舍，旁边流淌着一条小溪。

words.meaning: v. 阻碍；堵塞；n. 大块； 一排房屋； 街区
words.example: A fallen tree is blocking the road.
words.exampleTranslation: 一棵倒下的树把路阻断了。

words.meaning: v. 使固定；修理；安装；准备；n. 困境；方位；贿赂
words.example: He’s outside fixing the brakes on the car.
words.exampleTranslation: 他在外面修理汽车的刹车。

words.meaning: adj. 忙碌的；热闹的；正被占用的；v. 使忙于；n. (Busy)人名；(匈)布希；(法)比西
words.example: She’s busy now – can you phone later?
words.exampleTranslation: 她现在正忙，你稍后打来好吗？

words.meaning: n. 钱；货币；财富
words.example: Don’t spend all your money on the first day of your holiday!
words.exampleTranslation: 别在度假的第一天就把钱都花完了！

words.meaning: adj. 苦的；痛苦的；尖刻的；充满仇恨的；n. 苦味；苦啤酒；adv. 激烈地；严寒刺骨地；v. 使变苦
words.example: a bitter old man
words.exampleTranslation: 一个满腹怨恨的老人

words.meaning: adv. 在任何时候， 从来； 曾经
words.example: Nothing ever seems to upset him.
words.exampleTranslation: 似乎从来没有什么事情会使他烦恼。

words.meaning: n. 计算器
words.example: ...a pocket calculator.
words.exampleTranslation: …一个袖珍计算器。

words.meaning: n. 洋葱， 洋葱类植物
words.example: Chop the onions finely.
words.exampleTranslation: 把洋葱切碎。

words.meaning: adj. 每天的，日常的；n. 平时；寻常日子
words.example: the problems of everyday life
words.exampleTranslation: 日常生活中的问题

words.meaning: adj. 实际的；真实的；实在的；adv. 真正地；确实地；n. 现实；实数
words.example: There is a real danger that the disease might spread.
words.exampleTranslation: 这种疾病确实有蔓延的危险。

words.meaning: n. 米， 公尺
words.example: The iris of the eye is photographed from up to one meter away.
words.exampleTranslation: 眼睛的虹膜最远可在一公尺外的距离接受摄影。

words.meaning: n. 微波； 微波炉
words.example: I’ll heat it up in the microwave.
words.exampleTranslation: 我来把它用微波炉热一热。

words.meaning: v. 猜测；认为；推测；猜中；n. 猜测；推测
words.example: I’d say he’s around 50, but I’m only guessing.
words.exampleTranslation: 我想他50岁左右，不过也只是猜测。

words.meaning: adj. 适当的；本身的；特有的；正派的；adv. 完全地；n. (Proper)人名；(英、德)普罗珀
words.example: Everything was in its proper place (= where it should be ) .
words.exampleTranslation: 每样东西都放在恰当的位置。

words.meaning: adv. 好； 妥善地， 有利地； 令人满意地； 完全地； 充分地， 足够地； 很， 相当
words.example: Did you sleep well?
words.exampleTranslation: 你睡得好吗？

words.meaning: n. 自然；性质；本性；种类
words.example: We grew up in the countryside, surrounded by the beauties of nature.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们在乡村长大，周围是美丽的大自然。

words.meaning: adj. 前面的， 在前面的；n. 前面，正面；前线，战线
words.example: Two of his front teeth had been knocked out.
words.exampleTranslation: 他有两颗门牙被打落了。

words.meaning: adj. 不同的；个别的，与众不同的
words.example: The place looks completely different now.
words.exampleTranslation: 这地方现在完全变了。

words.meaning: adv. 只是，仅仅；刚才，刚刚；正好，恰好；实在；刚要；adj. 公正的，合理的；正直的，正义的；正确的；公平的；应得的；n. (Just)人名；(英)贾斯特；(法)朱斯特；(德、匈、波、捷、挪)尤斯特；(西)胡斯特
words.example: A good strong cup of coffee is just what I need right now.
words.exampleTranslation: 我现在正需要喝一杯浓浓的咖啡。

words.meaning: v. 呼叫；拜访；叫牌；n. 电话；呼叫；要求；访问
words.example: I heard someone calling in the distance.
words.exampleTranslation: 我听到远处有人在叫。

words.meaning: n. 暴风雨；大动荡；v. 起风暴；横冲直撞；狂怒咆哮
words.example: The weather forecast is for severe storms tonight.
words.exampleTranslation: 天气预报说今晚有强暴风雨。

words.meaning: adv. 在海外，在国外；adj. 海外的， 国外的，
words.example: Chris is going to work overseas.
words.exampleTranslation: 克里斯要去国外工作。

words.meaning: adj. 幸福的；高兴的；巧妙的；n. (Happy)人名；(英、瑞典、喀)哈皮
words.example: It’s a lovely house and we’ve been very happy here.
words.exampleTranslation: 房子很漂亮，我们住在这里非常开心。

words.meaning: adj. 确信的， 肯定的； 有信心的， 自信的
words.example: Despite her disability, Philippa is very confident.
words.exampleTranslation: 菲莉帕虽然有残疾，却很自信。

words.meaning: pron. 我们（主格）；笔者，本人（作者或演讲人使用）；朕，寡人；n. (We)人名；(缅)韦
words.example: ‘Did you go into the supermarket?’ ‘No, we didn’t.’
words.exampleTranslation: “你们进超级市场了吗？”“我们没有进去。”

words.meaning: v. 邀请，招待；招致；n. 邀请
words.example: I’m afraid I wasn’t invited.
words.exampleTranslation: 恐怕我没有受到邀请。

words.meaning: n. 生物学
words.example: a degree in biology
words.exampleTranslation: 生物学学位

words.meaning: adj. 勇敢的；华丽的；v. 勇敢地面对；n. 勇士
words.example: brave soldiers
words.exampleTranslation: 勇敢的士兵

words.meaning: v. 有…味道； 品尝； 体验， 感受；n. 滋味；味觉，口味；鉴赏力；兴趣，爱好
words.example: The food tasted better than it looked.
words.exampleTranslation: 这食物吃起来味道比看上去要好。

words.meaning: adj. 醒着的；v. [awoke-awaken] 醒， 唤醒； 意识到， 醒悟
words.example: I hope he’s awake now.
words.exampleTranslation: 我希望他现在醒着。

words.meaning: adj. 最低的， 最下的；n. 底，底部；末尾，尽头；臀部
words.example: It’s on the bottom shelf .
words.exampleTranslation: 它在架子的最底层。

words.meaning: n. 教堂；礼拜；教派；adj. 教会的；礼拜的；v. 领…到教堂接受宗教仪式
words.example: a short church service
words.exampleTranslation: 简短的教堂礼拜仪式

words.meaning: n. 物理学；物理现象
words.example: ...the laws of physics.
words.exampleTranslation: …物理学定律。

words.meaning: n. 爸爸
words.example: She lives with her mom and dad.
words.exampleTranslation: 她和爸爸妈妈一起住。

words.meaning: adv. 向东南；adj. 东南方的， 东南部的， 来自东南的；n. 东南，东南
words.example: I know we have to go southeast, more or less.
words.exampleTranslation: 我知道我们大概得往东南方向走。

words.meaning: n. 机会，际遇；运气，侥幸；可能性；v. 偶然发生；冒……的险
words.example: There’s always the chance that something will go wrong.
words.exampleTranslation: 总有可能会出现问题。

words.meaning: n. 篮子；（篮球比赛的）得分；一篮之量；篮筐；vt. 装入篮
words.example: a shopping basket
words.exampleTranslation: 购物篮

words.meaning: n. 圣诞节；圣诞节期间
words.example: Are you going home for Christmas?
words.exampleTranslation: 你回家过圣诞节吗？

words.meaning: v. 复述；再讲；重述
words.example: Lucilla often asks her sisters to retell the story.
words.exampleTranslation: 陆希拉经常叫她的姐姐们重讲那个故事。

words.meaning: v. [shut-shut, shutting]　关闭， 关上； 打烊
words.example: Shut the window, Ellen!
words.exampleTranslation: 埃伦，把窗关上！

words.meaning: n. 慈善， 施舍； 慈善机构
words.example: Several charities sent aid to the flood victims.
words.exampleTranslation: 有几家慈善机构已向洪灾灾民送去了救援物资。

words.meaning: v. （使）结冰，（使）冻结；n. 〔价格、工资等的〕冻结
words.example: The lake had frozen overnight.
words.exampleTranslation: 湖上一夜之间就结了冰。

words.meaning: n. 鲨鱼； 勒索者， 诈骗者； 放高利贷的人
words.example: Sharks were circling around our boat.
words.exampleTranslation: 鲨鱼在我们的小船周围游弋。

words.meaning: adj. 塑料的；（外科）造型的；可塑的；n. 塑料制品；整形；可塑体
words.example: a plastic spoon
words.exampleTranslation: 塑料汤匙

words.meaning: v. 欺骗；骗取；n. 欺骗，作弊；骗子
words.example: He had cheated in the test by using a calculator.
words.exampleTranslation: 他在考试时作弊，用了计算器。

words.meaning: prep. 在…的背后， 在…的后面； 落后于； 支持， 赞
words.example: I turned to speak to the person standing behind me.
words.exampleTranslation: 我转身和站在我后面的那人说话。

words.meaning: pron. 每个人；人人；n. 每个人
words.example: If everyone is ready, I’ll begin.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果大家都准备好了，我就开始。

words.meaning: adj. 短的；不足的；矮的，低的；n. 短；缺乏；短路；短裤；adv. 不足；突然；唐突地
words.example: a short meeting
words.exampleTranslation: 一个短会

words.meaning: n. 胃；腹部；胃口；v. 忍受；吃下
words.example: I was so hungry my stomach hurt.
words.exampleTranslation: 我饿得胃都痛了。

words.meaning: n. 注意力；关心；立正！（口令）
words.example: My attention wasn’t really on the game.
words.exampleTranslation: 我的注意力其实不在比赛上。

words.meaning: v. [hummed-hummed, humming] 哼曲子； 发出嗡嗡声； 忙碌， 充满活力
words.example: He began to hum a tune.
words.exampleTranslation: 他开始哼唱一支曲子。

words.meaning: n. 耳朵；穗；听觉；倾听；vi. （美俚）听见；抽穗
words.example: She tucked her hair behind her ears.
words.exampleTranslation: 她把头发拢到耳朵背后。

words.meaning: n. 份额；许多；命运；阄；adv. （与形容词和副词连用）很，非常；（与动词连用）非常；pron. 大量，许多；v. 分组，把…划分（常与out连用）；把（土地）划分成块
words.example: We’ve spent a lot on the children’s education.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们在孩子的教育上花费甚多。

words.meaning: n. 村庄；村民；（动物的）群落
words.example: a little fishing village
words.exampleTranslation: 一座小渔村

words.meaning: n. 警戒， 监视； ■望台， 监视哨； ■望员， 监视者； 与个人有关的事情， 任务
words.example: We’re always on the lookout for new business opportunities.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们一直在留意，等待新的商机。

words.meaning: n. 大衣，外套
words.example: I sprang 400 pounds for  her overcoat.
words.exampleTranslation: 给她买那件大衣，我花了400镑。

words.meaning: adv. 到处；n. 每个地方
words.example: I’ve looked everywhere but I can’t find the map.
words.exampleTranslation: 我到处都找过了，但就是找不到地图。

words.meaning: n. 一月
words.example: We always have snow in January.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们这里1月份总会下雪。

words.meaning: n. 杂志；弹药库；胶卷盒
words.example: a magazine article
words.exampleTranslation: 杂志中的文章

words.meaning: v. [met-met] 遇见， 碰到； 接； 和…见面， 和…会面
words.example: Meet me at 8.00.
words.exampleTranslation: 八点钟来见我。

words.meaning: adj. 奇怪的；陌生的；外行的；adv. 奇怪地；陌生地，冷淡地；n. (Strange)人名；(英)斯特兰奇；(瑞典、塞)斯特朗格
words.example: strange noises
words.exampleTranslation: 奇怪的噪声

words.meaning: n. 世界；领域；世俗；全人类；物质生活
words.example: Tuberculosis is still common in some parts of the world .
words.exampleTranslation: 结核病在世界上某些地区仍很常见。
